files.senators.json: everyone with a Senate floor vote this Congress, with their terms
files.votes.json: every floor roll call: question, result, counts, by party, what yes and no meant, why
files.positions.json: each senator's position on each vote: {vote id: {bioguide id: position}}
files.bills.json: every measure with a floor vote: title, importance, cost estimates, votes, explanations
files.committee_votes.json: verified committee roll calls with the count by party
files.nominations.json: nominations with a recorded vote and their 'if confirmed / if not' explanation

notes: A bill part marked held has no explanation yet: the AI's checker did not pass it, and no person has.
key_facts (40 bills) are the answer key's facts, shown until the AI explanations are written: see key_facts.about on each bill for how they were made and checked.
Committee votes that failed a check are held for review and left out.
